items.title: iPhone Duo Supports MagSafe Charging
items.description: Rumors about the foldable iPhone were unclear on whether it would have MagSafe charging, but it turns out the iPhone Duo does indeed have a magnetic charging array. Tech specs for the device say it supports ‌MagSafe‌ wireless charging at up to 25W, the same as the iPhone 18 Pro models. It also supports Qi2.2 25W wireless charging when using third-party accessories. Faster wired charging is available, with the iPhone Duo charging to 50 percent in a 20-minute period. That's a little bit slower than the ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ and Pro Max, which can charge to 50 percent in 15 minutes. The iPhone Duo goes on sale on October 16, and it will launch on October 23. Pricing starts at $1,999 for 256GB of storage.Related Roundup: iPhone FoldTag: MagSafeThis article, "iPhone Duo Supports MagSafe Charging" first appeared on MacRumors.comDiscuss this article in our forums

items.title: iPhone Duo: Pricing, Pre-Orders, and Release Date Announced
items.description: Apple's all-new foldable iPhone Duo will be available to pre-order starting on Friday, October 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific Time, and the device will be released on Friday, October 23, in the U.S. and more than 70 other countries and regions, including Australia, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Japan, Singapore, the U.K., and others. iPhone Duo will launch in 28 more countries and regions on Friday, October 30. In the U.S., pricing will start at $1,999 for a configuration with 256GB of storage. There are two color options: Star White and Night Sky. 512GB, 1TB, and 2TB storage capacities will also be available, with U.S. pricing going up to a whopping $3,199 for the 2TB configuration.Related Roundup: iPhone FoldThis article, "iPhone Duo: Pricing, Pre-Orders, and Release Date Announced" first appeared on MacRumors.comDiscuss this article in our forums
